title: What does a renderer do in a world-model stack?
summary: It generates what a world looks like, but appearance is not proof of physical validity.
body: A renderer generates observations such as images, video or interactive views from a viewpoint, prompt or scene description. Visual plausibility alone does not prove that geometry, physics or dynamics are correct.
